version: MOXIR v2 ground · every wash and beam on the floor
title: MOXIR v2 ground · the whole painted area, from the floor
what: The spread, with every wash and beam that is not on the truss brought down to the floor (owner 10-09 21:05): 40 PARs on the floor (the truss keeps 10), the hall's 36 no two closer than 6 m, three lighting the stage front (the DJ key and the two PA faces) from the pit; every floor PAR in the stage pen, a machine, a beam pen or its own fenced pen (32), so no standing eye is in its beam; B's ember fan behind the DJ as the owner saw it, and 12 beams in 4 fenced pens (square x 24 z 3; square x -24 z -21; col -12, span side, z 12..18; entry square x -8 z 33.5), each head with a desk window the pens hold; the truss, its lamps and the cubes as the spread had them (other workflows).
schema: the beta v0.9 snapshot schema (rigs/moxir-beta-v0.9-lights-2026-10-07.json: fixtures[{id,type,position,p,r,colour,angle_rad}] + solids[{id,name,kind,p,r,s}]), with status/moments/dmx/power_w/circuit per fixture and laser per cube. versions.mjs's rule schema places by mount rules and cannot hold per-unit positions; the build loads this file into a copy of beta as ops. v1.1 adds: stage (the booth move), views (the room buttons), checks_v1_1, crew, entrance, organiser.
frame: hall frame: metres, Y up, +x house right, +z toward the entry; rotations three.js Euler XYZ radians, a spot's unrotated beam points -Y; angle_rad = half the beam angle; box solids base-anchored; truss origin at the section centre, tower at the base plate (src/rigbuild/pieces.js), a tower's s[1] scales the 6 m catalogue tower.
base: MOXIR v1.1 (rigs/moxir-epic-v1-1-2026-10-08.json): the stage, the cut, the cranes, the PA placeholders, FOH, the barrier; the ash wall and cube 6's tower removed (all 6 cubes on the free crane, owner 10-09 N416)

requires.why: in thin air a beam is seen by its flux per width: the B380F's fixed 1.8 deg beam is already its narrowest; a gobo or prism takes flux out of the shaft (beamOptics.js: a prism of N facets gives N beams of 1/N the candela), so each shaft gets fainter. The room's gobo shapes are ASSUMED (no image of the wheel), so the claim that texture helps the eye in thin haze is not testable here.
requires.ground: 4 fenced beam pens (82 m of crowd barrier) + 32 fenced PAR pens (296 m) + the stage pen's barrier, all on the stewards' round; every floor B380F bolted to a ballasted floor plate (600 x 600 mm + 2 x 15 kg), levelled to +-1 deg, its desk window set (pan +-10 deg, tilt never below its aim) and its shutter closed on DMX loss and in a reset; B's fan strip marked on the stage floor; mesh guards on the two pit-end PARs; cable ramps at 1 power and 0 DMX crossings of the dance floor and the entry corridor; the venue's OK for floor plates
requires.safety_in_desk: B380F pan/tilt limits per head (desk_limits in each fixture: pan +-10 deg around its aim, tilt never below its aim; degrees from home and 16-bit DMX); shutter closed on DMX loss and during a reset
